BL-1398 — The commit-guard property fixture derives its guard set from run_commit_guards.sh instead of listing the guards by hand, so adding a guard to the runner can never turn the fixture red - as BL-1385's guard did today
What it solves: `required_wiring` anchor 1 is a genuine consumer anchor: the literal is
the runner's own line shape (`run_guard`), absent from the test today; it
can only appear if the test reads the runner.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Found by QA while landing; the red is a stale hand-written list, not a defect in any guard.
BL-1398 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1398" (or "reject BL-1398 <reason>") to act.
